status: Source binary parsing and DLL disassembly complete for the five normal Helicopters voice roles. Five-layer authored-Foley mixer implemented in both ports. Static review and asset encoding only; no compilation, unit/GameTests, client, native execution or media playback.

otherHandles.scope: Named files, volumes and default false flags are resolved. Source damage-threshold producer is not resolved, so these layers are not added to gameplay in this batch.

pitchControls.scope: 0x104a6e30 sends normalized control values through the distinct curves, using input range [0,1] and output range [.5,2], then changes pitch linearly by dt/smooth_ms towards the target. Both profiles have 3500 ms rise and 7500 ms fall. The original vehicle producer normalization is not inferred; Minecraft uses the documented actual-motion adapter below.
pitchControls.smoothingFormula: For increasing target, min(target,current+dt_ms/3500); for decreasing target, max(target,current-dt_ms/7500). 0x104a5f60 has a near-zero-duration direct assignment, unused by these profiles.

play.evidence: 0x104a67cd sets active byte +48, starts +14/+18/+0c/+1c and conditionally +20/+24.

stop.evidence: 0x104a68fe clears active byte +48, stops +1c/+14/+18/+0c/+20/+24, starts +10 winddown.

winddown.evidence: 0x104a6a41..0x104a6a61 calls 0x104a6450 to set voice +0x10 fade-out to 1000 ms, then 0x104a3b20 to play it. This separate command does not clear +0x48 like stop. The MC power edge uses stop semantics; it does not invent a separate winddown trigger.

actualMotionAdapter.producer: BlackwatchHelicopter server tick finally block, including early-return pilot/combat paths
actualMotionAdapter.powered: health > 0, phase is neither IDLE nor CRASH
actualMotionAdapter.quantization: Round both controls to 1/255 before syncing two new float entity-data fields. These are audio-only values; they do not affect flight or player input.
actualMotionAdapter.boundary: MC has no turbine/collective solver. Speed, acceleration and positive climb load are an explicit adapter, not a claim of recovered original input units; target distance is never used.

lifecycle: Create at most four groups within 96 blocks; evict beyond 100, removal, silence or world change.
Three running loops share one mixer update per unpaused client tick. Entering range of an already fully spun-up craft does not replay startup.
Power edges replace the transition one-shot. On stop the loop gain fades to zero while the winddown one-shot can finish.
Stopped/reloaded loops can restart without replaying ignition. A bounded one-shot lifetime permits cleanup after resource reload or muted audio.
adaptations: Linear fade envelope, 50 ms unpaused tick time, 96-block vanilla attenuation, four concurrent groups and two synced/quantized controls are MC policies.
Source min/max attenuation 35/285, reverb .5 and bus routing are retained as evidence, not represented as exact Minecraft acoustics.
All shipped waves are project-authored Foley. Original RADP data stays private and is never decoded, copied or relabeled as authored audio.

metadataReader.format: Patch typed properties are consumed to the exact chunk end; explicit ASCII names must equal uint64 hash = (hash * 65599) XOR next character. AudioFile RADP frame counts are metadata only: 20 bytes/channel encode 32 frames. No original PCM is decoded/exported.
